meta.title: Neural mind
meta.description: Shows the model's thinking as a live 3D neural graph shaped like a glowing brain. Open it from the Neural mind pill under the composer. In Chat mode, pick any chat in the header selector and the graph rebuilds into six lobes: reasoning, documents and references, tool actions, the outside world, execution and subagents, and the model with its task context. In Project mode, pick a workspace (or a folder group when no workspace registry is available) to see its chats as connected nodes, then open any chat to drill into its brain. Live thoughts stream in a banner above the brain, and committed thoughts, answers, commands, documents, plans, agent events and failures pop up as clickable cards tagged with their lobe; hover a node for its type and content; click it to read arguments, result and separate incoming/outgoing links. The sector legend explains each lobe on hover. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, and use the label, fullscreen and language controls (Russian, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese). The panel only reads the Session journal, sends nothing, and makes no model requests; it shares an already-open chat's events with the main window. Long journals show only the loaded tail: the task anchor then uses the session title (and says so), and older graph nodes fold away beyond the cap. Your prompts are their own class: diamond-outlined nodes down in the brainstem, a “My prompts” anchor, and a Classes lens that isolates prompts, thoughts, actions, documents, plans or context. A Media tab collects screenshots, renders and clips from the loaded journal as thumbnails; click one for a full preview, open its source node, or download it. When the journal is truncated, “Show earlier files” pages older history into the gallery. Newly created or accessed media also pops above the brain with a real thumbnail; the gallery keeps durable attachment images from tools and prompts plus deliverable image/video paths. A Files tab previews Markdown, CSV/TSV, code and other workspace text files safely, with copy, download, source-node jump and older-history paging; secret-like files are excluded. A history timeline can replay the whole loaded process: play/pause, speed, loop, stepping, scrubbing and milestone jumps; live cards are hidden while replaying. A Calls tab groups skill and MCP invocations with family filters, status and timing; on the brain they use a hexagon (skill) or port (MCP) glyph with labels, call counts and clickable cards.
